name: the Drill Yard
notes: Staff drills under the Vigil's eye. The only place to practise the roll without magic.

name: the Well of Quiet
secondary_gain: lesson +1 when a bond teaches here
notes: A dry well whose stones hum when the Wardstones drink. Old Quill sleeps here. The four mains meet here at night.

name: the Pit
who_gathers: Fire; anyone who wants a fight
notes: Unarmed sparring. Magic is impossible; stamina is everything. The Tent Trial is fought here.

name: the Scrap Market
secondary_gain: one secret per visit at guile >= 2
notes: Barter of what the Lanista lets through the Door.

name: the Commons Fire
notes: The only place the tents mix. Archetype (c) lives here.

name: the Granary
notes: Bread is the camp's real currency.

name: the Ditch
secondary_gain: one rumour the tents never hear
notes: Where the tentless sleep. A visit seen by your elder costs 1 trust.

name: the Door
primary_gain: scout (guile reveal); sign the Games board
notes: The grille in the great door. The arena is on the other side.

name: your Tent
primary_gain: trust +4 with tent-mates present; study with the elder
notes: Home. The elder hands out tent quests here.
